_comment: Weblate configuration for the Mysterria website. Applied by
scripts/provision_weblate.py. This file is the replacement for crowdin.yml.
THE TRADITIONAL CHINESE GUARD WORKS DIFFERENTLY HERE THAN ON CROWDIN.
On Crowdin the guard was 'never add zh-TW as a target language'. Weblate does
not work that way: it finds translations by globbing filemask against the
repository, and every zh-TW.json is committed. Without language_regex on each
component, Weblate imports them as editable translations, volunteers spend
time on them, and the next run of scripts/build-zh-tw.mjs silently overwrites
that work. The regex is the only thing preventing it. Do not relax it.
Weblate exposes every JSON leaf as translatable, including the structural
'id'). Weblate has no per-key exclusion for JSON, so that check stays the
backstop - see _notes.frozen_fields below for the bulk-edit follow-up.

_notes.linked_repos: Only the 'ui' component names a real git URL. The other four use repo 'weblate://mysterria-website/ui', which makes them share that single clone. Five independent clones of the same repository would otherwise fight each other on push and quintuple the disk and fetch cost.
_notes.file_format: json-nested, not json. The locale files are nested objects; the flat 'json' format would key them as literal dotted strings and lose the structure on write.
_notes.rules_filemask: 'rules_*.json' does not match 'staff_rules_en.json' - the filename has to start with 'rules_' - so the two components do not overlap. Verified, not assumed.
_notes.frozen_fields: check-i18n.mjs freezes rule 'id' and 'severity' and guide topic 'id' because the site keys off them. Weblate will still show them as translatable strings. Follow-up: add the 'Bulk edit' add-on to each component with query 'key:*.id OR key:*.severity' and flag 'read-only', which greys them out in the editor. Until then check-i18n.mjs in CI is what catches an edit.
_notes.vcs: github on the 'ui' component only; the other four inherit it through repo: weblate://mysterria-website/ui. Weblate opens a pull request on push_branch rather than committing to main. No credentials appear in these URLs and none are stored per-component: this repo is PUBLIC, so the clone is anonymous, and the push plus pull-request API use WEBLATE_GITHUB_TOKEN from the server's environment. Contrast the plugin repo, which is private and therefore has to carry credentials in its clone URL.
_notes.commit_messages: Deliberately unset. Weblate's project-level conventional-commit defaults are better than anything worth hardcoding and stay current across upgrades.
